name: Purple sticky rice
summary: Thái sticky rice soaked in the deep purple liquor of boiled lá khẩu cắm, then steamed. It is a feast rice, often set beside chéo cá nục.
origin: Xã Thuận Châu, in Báo Sơn La, 16 July 2026.
howToEat: As the purple rice, with chéo cá nục when that caption is the plate in front of you.
where: Xã Thuận Châu, and the Thái guest table. A shop was not named.
seoTitle: Xoi tim in Son La — purple rice from khau cam leaf
seoDescription: Xôi tím in Sơn La. Báo Sơn La dyes sticky rice with boiled lá khẩu cắm in xã Thuận Châu.
